title: SAP Fiori: SAPUI5 controls comunes
excerpt: Los controles UI más usados en SAPUI5.
body:
## Libraries principales

### sap.m (mobile-first, recomendado)
Most apps use this. Responsive.

### sap.ui.commons (legacy)
Deprecated. Don't use en new apps.

### sap.ui.table (advanced tables)
Grid-like tables para data-dense apps.

### sap.ui.layout (layout containers)
Grid, FlexBox, Form layouts.

### sap.viz (charts)
Charts (deprecating, use sap.suite.ui.commons.ChartContainer).

### sap.f (flexible layouts)
FlexibleColumnLayout, DynamicPage.

## Controles UI comunes

### Layout containers
```xml
<Page title='My Page'>
    <content>
        <VBox>
            <HBox>
                <Text text='Left'/>
                <Text text='Right'/>
            </HBox>
        </VBox>
    </content>
</Page>
```

### Text + labels
```xml
<Text text='Hello'/>
<Label text='Name:' labelFor='nameInput'/>
<Title text='Section'/>
<ObjectStatus text='Active' state='Success'/>
<ObjectIdentifier title='Product 123' text='In stock'/>
<ObjectNumber number='1500.00' unit='USD'/>
```

### Inputs
```xml
<Input value='{Name}' placeholder='Enter name'/>
<TextArea value='{Description}' rows='4'/>
<CheckBox selected='{IsActive}' text='Active'/>
<RadioButtonGroup selectedIndex='{Option}'>
    <RadioButton text='Yes'/>
    <RadioButton text='No'/>
</RadioButtonGroup>
<Switch state='{Enabled}'/>
<Slider value='{Volume}' min='0' max='100'/>
<StepInput value='{Quantity}' min='1' step='1'/>
<DatePicker value='{DueDate}'/>
<DateTimePicker value='{ScheduledAt}'/>
<TimePicker value='{Time}'/>
<Select selectedKey='{Country}'>
    <items>
        <core:Item key='CO' text='Colombia'/>
        <core:Item key='MX' text='Mexico'/>
    </items>
</Select>
<ComboBox selectedKey='{City}'>
    <items>
        <core:Item key='BOG' text='Bogota'/>
    </items>
</ComboBox>
<MultiComboBox selectedKeys='{Categories}'>
    <items>
        <core:Item key='electronics' text='Electronics'/>
    </items>
</MultiComboBox>
<TokenInput/>
```

### Buttons
```xml
<Button text='Save' type='Emphasized' icon='sap-icon://save' press='.onSave'/>
<Button text='Delete' type='Reject' icon='sap-icon://delete' press='.onDelete'/>
<Button icon='sap-icon://edit' tooltip='Edit'/>
<MenuButton text='Actions'>
    <menu>
        <Menu>
            <MenuItem text='Copy'/>
            <MenuItem text='Duplicate'/>
        </Menu>
    </menu>
</MenuButton>
```

### Button types
- **Default**
- **Emphasized** (primary action, blue)
- **Reject** (destructive, red)
- **Accept** (green)
- **Transparent**
- **Ghost**

### Navigation
```xml
<Link href='#Product-view?ID=123' text='View'/>
<Breadcrumbs>
    <Link text='Home'/>
    <Link text='Products'/>
    <Text text='Current'/>
</Breadcrumbs>
<TabContainer>
    <TabContainerItem name='Tab 1'>
        <content>...</content>
    </TabContainerItem>
</TabContainer>
<IconTabBar>
    <IconTabFilter icon='sap-icon://email' text='Emails'/>
</IconTabBar>
```

### Display / visualization
```xml
<Avatar src='sap-icon://person-placeholder' displaySize='M'/>
<ObjectMarker type='Flagged'/>
<RatingIndicator value='4' maxValue='5' displayOnly='true'/>
<ProgressIndicator percentValue='60' state='Success'/>
<TileContainer/>
<GenericTile header='Sales' subheader='This month'>
    <tileContent>
        <TileContent><NumericContent value='1245' valueColor='Good'/></TileContent>
    </tileContent>
</GenericTile>
```

### Icons
SAP icon font ~1000+ icons:
- `sap-icon://save`
- `sap-icon://edit`
- `sap-icon://delete`
- `sap-icon://search`
- `sap-icon://sap-logo-shape`

Browse: https://experience.sap.com/icons/

### Loading
```xml
<BusyIndicator size='2rem'/>
<BusyDialog title='Loading...' text='Please wait'/>
```

### Alerts
```xml
<MessageStrip text='Info message' type='Information' showIcon='true'/>
```

### Charts (sap.viz o sap.chart)
```xml
<viz:Popover xmlns:viz='sap.viz.ui5.controls'/>
<viz:VizFrame vizType='column' width='400px' height='300px'/>
```

Complex — usually use ChartContainer wrapper.

### Advanced (sap.f)
```xml
<f:FlexibleColumnLayout beginColumnPages='...' midColumnPages='...' endColumnPages='...'/>
<f:DynamicPage>
    <f:title>
        <f:DynamicPageTitle/>
    </f:title>
    <f:content>
        <!-- content -->
    </f:content>
</f:DynamicPage>
```

## Best practices
- **sap.m preferred** unless specific reason to use other libraries
- **Consistent controls** — use same button type for same action across app
- **Icons + text** cuando espacio permite (mejor UX)
- **Accessibility** — labels asociados a inputs (labelFor)

title: SAP Fiori: deploy y publish a launchpad
excerpt: Deploy Fiori app y publicarla en el launchpad.
body:
## Deployment options

### 1. ABAP repository (on-prem)
For S/4HANA / ECC on-prem:
```bash
npx fiori deploy --config ui5-deploy.yaml
```

### ui5-deploy.yaml
```yaml
specVersion: '3.0'
metadata:
    name: my-fiori-app
type: application
builder:
    resources: { ... }
customTasks:
    - name: deploy-to-abap
      afterTask: replaceVersion
      configuration:
          target:
              url: https://my-system.empresa.local:8443
              client: 100
          app:
              name: ZMYAPP
              description: Mi App
              package: ZUI5_APPS
              transport: DEV000123
```

### 2. HTML5 App Repository (BTP)
```bash
mbt build
cf deploy mta_archives/*.mtar
```

### 3. BTP Kyma
Deploy container to Kyma runtime.

### 4. Standalone (HTTP server)
Just static files. Any web server works (nginx, Apache).

## Publish to Fiori launchpad (on-prem)

### Steps
1. Deploy app to ABAP repo
2. Create OData service en `/IWFND/MAINT_SERVICE` (SEGW / ABAP CDS)
3. Create tile en `/UI2/FLPD_CUST`
4. Assign to catalog
5. Assign catalog to PFCG role
6. Users see tile

## Publish to launchpad (BTP)

### Content manager
BTP cockpit → **Work Zone → Site → Content Manager**:
- Assign app to content
- Assign role
- Publish

Users with role → tile aparece.

## App Router (BTP)
MTA con approuter serves:
- Serves static UI5 files from HTML5 App Repo
- Handles auth (XSUAA)
- Routes API calls via destinations

### xs-app.json
```json
{
    'routes': [
        {
            'source': '/api/(.*)',
            'destination': 'S4HANA_DEST',
            'authenticationType': 'xsuaa'
        },
        {
            'source': '^(.*)',
            'localDir': 'resources',
            'authenticationType': 'xsuaa'
        }
    ]
}
```

## Versioning
Deployed app version tracked. Multiple versions can coexist:
- Users see latest by default
- Admin can rollback

## Test post-deploy
1. Login as different user roles
2. Verify tile visible
3. Click tile → app loads
4. Basic CRUD works
5. Data displayed correctly

## Transport (on-prem)
UI5 app + backend service en transport request. Move through TMS.

## Automation
### CI/CD pipeline
```yaml
name: Deploy Fiori
on: push:

jobs:
    build-and-deploy:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            - run: npm ci
            - run: npm run build
            - run: npx fiori deploy --config ui5-deploy.yaml --username $CF_USER --password $CF_PASS
```

## Common issues

### 'App not visible en launchpad'
- Catalog not assigned to role
- User no tiene role
- Cache: refresh launchpad Ctrl+Shift+R

### 'Component failed to load'
- Manifest.json path wrong
- Missing dependencies
- Bundle not generated (missed `mbt build`)

### 'Data load fails'
- Destination not configured
- Backend down
- Auth issue (XSUAA)

## Rollback
BTP: redeploy previous MTA version.
ABAP: transport reverse.

## Monitoring post-deploy
- Application Logs
- Error rate en Kibana
- User feedback
- App analytics (if enabled)

title: SAP Fiori: troubleshooting app no carga
excerpt: Diagnóstico cuando una app Fiori no arranca.
body:
## Síntomas
- Tile click → blank page
- Loading spinner infinite
- Error 'Component could not be loaded'
- 404 al navegar

## Steps

### 1. Browser console
F12 → Console tab. Ver errors:
- Syntax error in JS
- 404 for resource
- CORS blocking

### 2. Network tab
Check HTTP requests:
- Manifest.json loaded? Should be 200 OK
- Component-preload.js loaded?
- OData metadata endpoint reachable?

### 3. Common errors

#### 'Failed to load Component-preload.js'
- Bundle not deployed properly
- Or path issue en manifest

Fix: rebuild + redeploy.

#### 'Cannot read manifest.json'
- App not deployed
- URL routing wrong
- Server 404

#### 'XmlHttpRequest failed loading metadata.xml'
- OData service down
- Wrong URL en manifest.dataSources
- Auth: user not authorized

#### 'Component controller can't be created'
- Syntax error en Component.js o controller
- Missing dependency (require path)

#### 'Not defined: sap.m.Table'
- Library not loaded en manifest dependencies
- Add lib to `sap.ui5.dependencies.libs`

### 4. Enable UI5 diagnostics
`Ctrl+Alt+Shift+P` — dialog aparece:
- Version info
- Component status
- Model bindings

### 5. Enable trace
Append `?sap-ui-debug=true&sap-ui-log-level=TRACE` a URL.

All internal SAPUI5 logs printed to console.

### 6. Fiori launchpad diagnostics
Append `?sap-flp-url-signed=X` (needed for some launchpad URLs).

Or URL `#Shell-diag` → launchpad diagnostic screen.

### 7. Backend logs
Si app OK pero data no aparece:
- SM21 (system log) in backend
- SICF trace
- /IWFND/ERROR_LOG (Gateway errors)

## Specific: 500 error at data load
- Backend OData service en 'error' state
- SICF service not active
- User no autorizado (S_SERVICE)

### Check en backend
1. `/IWFND/MAINT_SERVICE` → verify service registered + active
2. `/IWFND/GW_CLIENT` → test service directly
3. `SU53` — auth check inmediately after failure

## Specific: bundle issues
### 'Component-preload.js not found'
- Not built with `ui5 build` or `mbt build`
- Deployment missed the bundle

### 'Preload bundle stale'
- Users see old version despite new deploy
- Cache issue

Fix:
- Deploy new version bumps version en manifest
- Users force-refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R)
- Or expose fresh version URL con hash

## Specific: CORS
### 'CORS policy blocking'
- Backend not sending CORS headers
- Destination proxy not configured

Fix en app router (xs-app.json):
```json
{
    'source': '/api/(.*)',
    'destination': 'BACKEND',
    'authenticationType': 'xsuaa',
    'csrfProtection': false
}
```

## Debug de OData model
```javascript
oModel.attachRequestFailed((oEvent) => {
    console.error('OData failed:', oEvent.getParameters());
});

oModel.attachRequestSent((oEvent) => {
    console.log('OData request:', oEvent.getParameters());
});
```

## Debug routing
```javascript
this.getRouter().attachRoutePatternMatched(oEvent => {
    console.log('Route matched:', oEvent.getParameter('name'));
});
```

## UI5 test tools
- **OPA5** — one page acceptance testing
- **QUnit** — unit tests

Run tests si app broken to catch specific regression.

## Common resolutions
1. Rebuild + redeploy
2. Clear browser cache
3. Verify destination config
4. Verify auth roles
5. Check backend service

title: SAP Fiori: authorization con S_SERVICE
excerpt: Configurar autorización backend para Fiori apps.
body:
## Layers de auth para Fiori app

### 1. Launchpad tile visible
User role → catalog assignment → tile visible.

### 2. Component load
User needs `S_TCODE` for the Fiori launchpad transaction (usually `/UI2/FLP` o custom).

### 3. OData service access
User needs `S_SERVICE` auth object with right value.

### 4. Backend business auth
User needs standard authorizations for the underlying business objects (like `S_TABU_DIS`, `M_MSEG_BMB`, etc.).

## S_SERVICE object
Critical for OData services:
- Field: `SRV_NAME` — service name
- Field: `SRV_TYPE` — HT (HTTP), WS (webservice)
- Field: `CTS_LEVEL` — check level (typically empty)

### Values
Assigned via SU24 + PFCG:
- `SRV_NAME = SD_ORDER_SRV_0001`
- `SRV_TYPE = HT`

## Ver services registered
`/IWFND/MAINT_SERVICE` — list of activated services + description.

## User's SU53 shows S_SERVICE missing
1. Admin → PFCG del user's role
2. Tab **Authorizations** → **Change**
3. Buscar `S_SERVICE`
4. Add values (or generate SU24 defaults)
5. Generate + save + assign
6. User relogin

## SU24 (recommended)
Configura defaults for a transaction/service:
1. `SU24` → transaction or service name
2. Ver auth objects checked
3. Set values
4. Save

When PFCG generates role, uses these defaults.

## Fiori catalog / role structure

### Business catalog (PFCG role)
- Contains launchpad tiles + target mappings
- User role assignment → sees tiles

### Backend role (PFCG)
- Contains S_SERVICE + business auth
- User needs both roles (or composite role)

### Composite role (recommended)
One role bundling:
- Frontend (catalog with tiles)
- Backend (S_SERVICE + business auth)

User gets composite → gets everything needed.

## Fiori standard roles
SAP delivers pre-built:
- `SAP_BR_EMPLOYEE`
- `SAP_BR_MANAGER`
- `SAP_BR_ADMINISTRATOR`
- Etc.

Start with these, customize for your org.

## Assign to user
`SU01` → user → tab **Roles** → add:
- Composite role: `Z_FIORI_SALES_USER`

After save → **User Comparison** → applies auth.

## Debug auth issues

### SU53
After user fails auth:
- User: `/nSU53`
- Copy screenshot to admin
- Admin adds missing auth

### ST01 authorization trace
Deep trace:
1. `ST01` → auth trace on for user
2. User reproduces issue
3. ST01 → see sequence of auth checks (success + failure)

### /IWFND/ERROR_LOG
Specifically for Fiori/OData errors:
- Filter by user
- Ver auth failures + technical details

## Sometimes 403 not auth
Also caused by:
- Service not active en SICF
- CSRF token invalid
- Session expired

Rule out these before auth debugging.

## Best practices
- **Composite roles** para business scenarios
- **Test roles** as different users in QA before prod
- **Least privilege** — grant only what's needed
- **Audit annually** — remove obsolete roles
- **Document role purpose** en description

title: SAP Fiori: mobile app + iOS/Android
body:
## Native mobile apps SAP

### SAP Mobile Start
App iOS/Android que aggregates:
- BTP Work Zone content
- Fiori launchpad tiles
- Corporate news

Deployed via MDM (Intune, Jamf).

### SAP Fiori Client
App específicamente para Fiori launchpad on-prem:
- Cordova-based
- Wraps launchpad URL
- Provides native features (camera, notifications)

Deprecating en favor de Mobile Start + PWA.

### SAP Asset Manager, SAP Cloud for Customer, etc.
Specific-purpose apps built con MDK (Mobile Development Kit).

## PWA approach
Fiori apps are Progressive Web Apps by default:
- Responsive design
- Add to home screen
- Offline capabilities (limited)

Users open browser → open bookmark → looks like native app.

## Responsive design
Use `sap.m` library — auto-adapts:
- Desktop: multi-column
- Tablet: 2-column with drawer
- Mobile: 1-column stacked

## Layout patterns
### Master-Detail
```xml
<SplitApp>
    <masterPages>
        <Page>List</Page>
    </masterPages>
    <detailPages>
        <Page>Detail</Page>
    </detailPages>
</SplitApp>
```

Desktop: side-by-side
Mobile: navigate list → detail

### Flexible Column Layout (FCL)
```xml
<f:FlexibleColumnLayout layout='ThreeColumnsMidExpanded'>
    <f:beginColumnPages/>
    <f:midColumnPages/>
    <f:endColumnPages/>
</f:FlexibleColumnLayout>
```

## Touch interactions
- Swipe (via `TouchStart`, `TouchMove` events)
- Pull-to-refresh
- Long-press context menus

## Camera access
```javascript
navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: true }).then(stream => {
    // Access camera
});
```

Requires HTTPS.

## Push notifications
PWA:
- Web Push API
- Service worker registered
- User grants permission

Native wrapper:
- APNs (Apple)
- FCM (Firebase)

## Offline (limited PWA)
Service worker caches static assets. Data offline more complex:
- IndexedDB for local storage
- Sync when online (background sync API)

For real offline con full sync: MDK apps.

## Testing en mobile
### Real devices
Deploy to test devices via MDM.

### Simulators
- iOS Simulator (Xcode)
- Android Emulator (Android Studio)

### Chrome device emulation
F12 → Toggle device toolbar → simulate mobile viewports.

## Common issues
- **Touch not registering** — event handlers wrong
- **Slow scroll** — optimize DOM size
- **Broken layout mobile** — no test on real device beforehand

## Distribution
### Corporate
- MDM (Intune, Jamf)
- Managed app config

### Public
- App Store (Apple)
- Google Play

Requires enterprise developer account + review process.

## Best practices
- **Test on real devices** early
- **Touch-friendly UI** — large tap targets (44px min)
- **Reduce data** — mobile users may have limited bandwidth
- **Progressive enhancement** — desktop features gracefully degrade en mobile
- **Fast load** — mobile networks slower than desktop

title: SAP Fiori: variantes y personalización
body:
## Variant management
User saves filter/sort/columns config:
- Public (admin, shared)
- Private (user's own)

### En Fiori Elements LROP
Automatic — filter bar has variant selector.

### En freestyle
Add `sap.ui.comp.variants.VariantManagement` control:
```xml
<smart:VariantManagement id='vm' persistencyKey='myapp.mainpage'/>
```

## Layout personalization
SAP UI5 Flexibility framework:
- Users hide columns
- Reorder
- Change titles
- Add custom text

Runtime authoring (RTA):
- **Enter Adapt UI mode** — Ctrl+Shift+P → Adapt UI
- Drag/drop, right-click contextual
- Save

## Storage
Personalization stored in `sap.ui.fl` layer:
- **User** — per user
- **Customer_base** — customer-wide default
- **Customer** — customer-wide override
- **Partner** — partner-provided

### Backend storage
- **On-prem**: `LREP` (Layered Repository)
- **BTP**: HTML5 App Repo or dedicated Flex service

## Assign to role
Admin can lock down which personalization possible per role.

### Restrict via manifest
```json
'sap.ui5': {
    'flexEnabled': true,
    'flexExtensionPointEnabled': true
}
```

## Save changes
### As user
Automatic when leaving RTA mode.

### As admin (customer_base)
Enter RTA → save as 'default for all users'.

Requires admin auth.

## Transport
Flex changes can be transported como other artifacts:
- Change register en transport
- Move dev → qa → prod

## Common features personalizable
- Table columns (visibility + order)
- Filter presets (variants)
- Section visibility (Object Page)
- Field labels
- Chart types (Analytical List Page)

## Programmatic manipulation
```javascript
var oFlex = sap.ui.fl.registry.ChangeRegistry.getInstance();
// Advanced use only
```

## Reset
User: settings → **Reset all personalization**.

Or admin can lock certain changes if compliance requires uniformity.

## Analytics
SAP UI Analytics — see which fields users hide most (indicates poor UI design).

## Best practices
- **Enable RTA** for power users
- **Provide sensible defaults** — no todos deben editar
- **Public variants** for common scenarios
- **Document** available personalization options

title: SAP Fiori: analytical apps + charts
body:
## Analytical patterns
- **Analytical List Page (ALP)** — Fiori Elements template combining chart + table + filter
- **Overview Page (OVP)** — dashboard con tiles
- **Report** — freestyle dashboard

## Analytical List Page (ALP)
Best for exploring aggregated data.

### Componentes
- Filter bar
- Chart (con drill-down)
- Table (below chart, filtered by chart selection)

### Annotations
```cds
annotate SalesService.Orders with @(
    UI: {
        Chart: {
            ChartType: #Column,
            Dimensions: [category],
            Measures: [revenue]
        },
        LineItem: [
            { Value: orderId },
            { Value: customer },
            { Value: revenue }
        ],
        SelectionFields: [category, year]
    }
);
```

## Overview Page (OVP)
Dashboard-style. Cards representing KPIs.

### Card types
- **List card** — list of items
- **Analytic card** — chart + KPI
- **Table card**
- **Stack card**
- **KPI card** (numeric)

### Config
```json
'sap.ovp': {
    'cards': {
        'salesKPI': {
            'model': 'salesModel',
            'template': 'sap.ovp.cards.kpi',
            'settings': {
                'entitySet': 'SalesKPI',
                'title': 'Sales This Month'
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## Chart controls

### sap.viz (deprecating)
```xml
<viz:VizFrame xmlns:viz='sap.viz.ui5.controls'
    vizType='column'
    dataset='{...}'/>
```

### sap.chart (recommended)
```xml
<chart:Chart xmlns:chart='sap.chart'
    dimensions='...'
    measures='...'
    chartType='column'/>
```

### Chart Container wrapper
```xml
<VizContainer chart='{ ... }' />
```

Provides:
- Chart type switcher
- Legend
- Zoom
- Export options

## KPI display
### NumericContent
```xml
<NumericContent value='1245' valueColor='Good' indicator='Up' scale='K'/>
```

Displays: `1245 K↑` en green.

### Formatter for large numbers
```javascript
formatValue: function(value) {
    if (value > 1e6) return (value / 1e6).toFixed(1) + 'M';
    if (value > 1e3) return (value / 1e3).toFixed(1) + 'K';
    return value.toString();
}
```

## Chart types
- **Column / Bar**
- **Line / Timeseries**
- **Pie / Donut**
- **Scatter / Bubble**
- **Area**
- **Combined** (column + line)

## Drill down
User clicks chart data → filter table below to that segment.

Fiori Elements ALP does this automatically.

### Custom
```javascript
onChartSelect: function(oEvent) {
    var oSelected = oEvent.getParameters().data;
    // Filter table
    this._filterTable(oSelected);
}
```

## Cross-app KPI navigation
KPI on OVP → click → navigate to detail app with filter applied.

Uses intent-based navigation.

## Performance
- Server-side aggregation (OData `$apply=groupby`)
- Don't load raw records for millions of rows
- Cache aggregates

## SAP Analytics Cloud embedding
For complex dashboards, embed SAC content en Fiori:
- iframe
- Or SAC widget en OVP

Más poderoso que Fiori Elements analytics.

title: SAP Fiori: SAPUI5 upgrade y compatibility
excerpt: Manejar upgrades de SAPUI5 framework en apps.
body:
## SAPUI5 versioning
- Major: 1.x (current)
- Minor: 1.120, 1.121, 1.122...
- Patch: 1.120.5

## LTS releases
- SAP LTS versions supported 3+ years
- Non-LTS versions: 6 months

### Recent LTS
- 1.108 LTS
- 1.120 LTS (current)
- 1.130 LTS (upcoming)

## Version selection
manifest.json:
```json
'sap.ui5': {
    'dependencies': {
        'minUI5Version': '1.120.0'
    }
}
```

Specifies minimum. Runtime uses closest available (usually latest supported en launchpad).

## Ver actual version
Browser console: `sap.ui.version` → prints version.

O F12 → resources → check UI5 script src.

## Upgrade strategy

### Reading release notes
Before upgrading:
- SAP UI5 release notes
- Breaking changes list
- Deprecation notices

https://openui5.hana.ondemand.com/versionoverview.html

### Test in dev environment
1. Change minUI5Version en manifest
2. Deploy to dev
3. Test all critical paths
4. Check console for errors/warnings

### Deprecations
Runtime warnings en console:
```
[deprecation] sap.m.OldControl is deprecated. Use sap.m.NewControl instead.
```

Fix these BEFORE they become removals in future version.

### Common breaking changes
- API method removals (deprecated N versions before)
- Control property changes
- Model behavior changes (v4 improvements)
- CSS class renames

## Compatibility flag
Some flags for legacy behavior:
```json
'sap.ui5': {
    'contentDensities': {
        'compact': true,
        'cozy': true
    }
}
```

## OpenUI5 vs SAPUI5
- **OpenUI5** — Apache 2 open source
- **SAPUI5** — SAP superset (Fiori Elements, chart libs, etc.)

For most apps, use SAPUI5 (bundled with Fiori launchpad).

## CDN vs bundled
- **CDN**: `https://sapui5.hana.ondemand.com/1.120.5/resources/sap-ui-core.js` — latest features but internet-dependent
- **Bundled**: local UI5 en enterprise deployments — no internet needed

## Testing upgrades en CI
Automated regression tests OPA5 catch issues:
```yaml
# CI matrix testing
matrix:
    ui5-version: ['1.108', '1.120', '1.122']
```

## Ver upcoming deprecations
SAP publishes deprecation calendar. Plan mitigations.

## Rollback
If upgrade breaks:
- Revert manifest.json minUI5Version
- Redeploy
- Users see previous version

## Backwards compatibility
SAP tries hard for compat, but not perfect. Test thoroughly.

## Version en production
Launchpad may pin specific version. Coordinate with basis/admin team antes de upgrade.

## Custom controls impact
If you built custom controls extending SAPUI5 base classes:
- API changes may break your code
- Refactor con new APIs

## Best practices
- **Use LTS versions** for stability
- **Upgrade every 1-2 years** minimum (stay supported)
- **Test in dev/qa** first
- **Read release notes** cover to cover
- **Address deprecations** proactively (don't wait until removal)

title: SAP Fiori: accessibility (WCAG)
body:
## SAPUI5 accessibility
Built-in for standard controls:
- Keyboard navigation
- Screen reader labels (ARIA)
- High contrast themes

## Standards
- **WCAG 2.1 AA** — target level
- **Section 508** — US government
- **EN 301 549** — EU

## Keyboard navigation
Users can navigate without mouse:
- **Tab** — move to next control
- **Shift+Tab** — previous
- **Enter / Space** — activate
- **Arrow keys** — navigate lists/tables/menus
- **Esc** — cancel/close dialog

Test: unplug mouse, verify entire app usable.

## Focus management
- Focus visible (outline visible)
- Focus moves logically
- After dialog close, focus returns to trigger element

### Manual focus
```javascript
this.byId('nameInput').focus();
```

## Labels
Inputs must have labels:
```xml
<Label text='Name:' labelFor='nameInput'/>
<Input id='nameInput' value='{Name}'/>
```

`labelFor` associates.

### ARIA labels
For controls without visible label:
```xml
<Button icon='sap-icon://delete' tooltip='Delete item' ariaLabel='Delete item'/>
```

## Alt text
Images:
```xml
<Image src='logo.png' alt='Company logo'/>
```

Decorative:
```xml
<Image src='decorative.png' decorative='true'/>
```

## Color contrast
WCAG requires:
- Normal text: 4.5:1 contrast ratio
- Large text: 3:1

SAP horizon theme meets AA. Custom themes may fail — test.

Tools: WebAIM Contrast Checker.

## Don't rely on color alone
- Error indicator: red color + icon + text
- Success: green + checkmark + text

Color-blind users need alternatives.

## Form labels
Required fields must be indicated:
- Asterisk (visual)
- ARIA `aria-required='true'` (auto by SAPUI5 con `required='true'`)

## Skip links
At page top, invisible link to jump to main content:
```xml
<Link text='Skip to main content' visible='false' focusable='true'/>
```

Appears when tabbed.

## Tables
- Column headers with proper `Text` content
- `Row headers` para complex tables
- Screen readers announce structure

## Dialogs
ARIA `role='dialog'` and `aria-modal='true'` (SAPUI5 sets automatically).

Focus trapped inside dialog until closed.

## Test tools

### Chrome DevTools Accessibility panel
F12 → Elements → Accessibility.

Shows ARIA tree.

### Lighthouse
Audit → Accessibility section.

### axe DevTools (Chrome extension)
Automated a11y checks.

### Manual
- Screen reader test (NVDA free en Windows, VoiceOver Mac)
- Keyboard-only navigation
- Zoom to 200% — still usable?

## High contrast theme
`sap_horizon_hcb` (black), `sap_horizon_hcw` (white).

Users with vision impairment can switch en launchpad preferences.

## Language
HTML lang attribute:
```xml
<!-- BAS generates automatically -->
<html lang='es'>
```

Screen readers pronounce correctly.

## Best practices
- **Test with actual users** (accessibility beta)
- **Semantic HTML** — proper heading hierarchy (h1, h2, h3)
- **Meaningful link text** — 'Read more' with context, not just 'here'
- **Avoid time limits** — or provide extend option
- **Consistent navigation** — same across screens

## Compliance
Enterprise apps often required by law:
- Public sector
- Regulated industries
- International (accessibility laws vary)

Audit annually. Document exceptions and mitigations.

title: SAP Fiori: horizon design system
excerpt: Horizon — new SAP design system, current default.
body:
## Horizon
SAP's new design system (2022+):
- Modernized UI
- Better contrast
- More whitespace
- Refined typography
- Consistent iconography

Default theme para Fiori apps + BTP Work Zone.

## vs Fiori 3
Horizon is next-gen. Retains familiarity but modernizes.

### Cambios visuales
- Rounded corners
- Subtler shadows
- Modernized icons
- Cleaner colors

## Enable Horizon
Set en manifest:
```json
'sap.ui5': {
    'theme': 'sap_horizon'
}
```

Or en app launcher (user preference).

## Variants
- **sap_horizon** — light
- **sap_horizon_dark**
- **sap_horizon_hcb** — high contrast black (accessibility)
- **sap_horizon_hcw** — high contrast white

## Dark mode
```javascript
sap.ui.getCore().applyTheme('sap_horizon_dark');
```

User preference support:
- Toggle en launchpad settings
- Or auto based on OS preference

## Custom Horizon-based theme
Theme Designer:
- Base: sap_horizon
- Modify colors: brand primary, accent
- Deploy custom theme
- Users switch en preferences

## Control coverage
Most controls updated to Horizon:
- Buttons, inputs, labels
- Tables, lists
- Cards, tiles
- Dialogs, popovers

Some legacy controls (sap.ui.commons) not updated — use sap.m alternatives.

## Guidelines

### Typography
- Primary font: **72** SAP proprietary font
- Fallback: system fonts
- Sizes documented en design guidelines

### Colors
- Primary: blue accent (#0070f2 default)
- Semantic: success (green), warning (orange), error (red)
- Neutral grays for text/backgrounds

### Spacing
- 4px base unit
- Multiples: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48

### Corner radius
- Small: 4px
- Medium: 8px
- Large: 12px

### Shadow
- Elevated cards: soft shadow
- Sticky elements: stronger

## Design tokens
Horizon defines CSS variables:
```css
:root {
    --sapButton_Background: #ffffff;
    --sapButton_TextColor: #333333;
    /* ... hundreds more */
}
```

Customize via Theme Designer to override tokens.

## Fiori guidelines updated
https://experience.sap.com/fiori-design-web/

Updated with Horizon guidelines:
- Layouts
- Patterns
- Content structure

## Migration Fiori 3 → Horizon
- Change theme name
- Test all screens
- Custom styles may need updates

SAP maintains backward-compat mostly. Test thoroughly.

## Icon updates
Horizon icons more refined. Same names, different visuals.

Appear automatically when Horizon theme active.

## Business context
More emphasis on:
- **Task-oriented UI** — clear next action
- **Progressive disclosure** — reveal details as user drills in
- **Consistent patterns** — reduces learning curve

## Fiori evolution
Horizon = current. Future SAP UX iterations will build on Horizon foundation.
